# Qendresa Hoti

## Who I am
I'm Qendresa Hoti, a software engineer, founder, and creator with nine years of experience building products and communities. I believe everyone should get to be a builder. I build with Claude Code and Codex every day and post what runs, what goes sideways, and what would make your work easier. That connects the tools I ship, the hackathons I run, and the prompts and skills I give away here.

## What this site is for
qendresa.dev helps you start building, technical or not. It holds my writing, projects, talks, and newsletter.

## What I make
- The harness tax: https://github.com/kju4q/q-agent-harness/blob/main/docs/harness-tax.md
  Same model, five times the bill.
- Where your data goes (video): https://www.instagram.com/qendresahhoti
  An agent reads Notion and Temu before sign up.

  What the HuggingFace harness study changed.
